name: lince-registry
goal: You are the Platform Soldier for this repo: the architecture below is already decided by the Underboss — execute it exactly, no redesign, no scope drift. Mission: replace the hardcoded agent if/else in harness/agents.py with a declarative registry modeled on the LINCE agent-registration contract (lince-add-supported-agent): each agent declares its own requirements — binary, headless argv shape, enforcement tier — so adding a new coding agent becomes one registry entry plus a validation step, never an edit of control flow.
accept: harness/agents.py: introduce AGENT_SPECS, an immutable mapping name -> spec with fields: binary (executable to probe), argv builder (prompt -> argv list), enforcement tier (claude='guard-hook', codex='sandbox+verify'), human description. claude must yield exactly ['claude','-p',prompt,'--permission-mode','acceptEdits']; codex exactly ['codex','exec','--sandbox','workspace-write',prompt].
AGENTS, build_argv and the unknown-agent error derive from AGENT_SPECS; error message lists registry keys. Existing argv behavior byte-identical.

harness/server.py and harness/runner.py (if it hardcodes agent names): agent validation and the TOOLS probe read agent binaries from the registry instead of literals; non-agent TOOLS entries stay as they are.

New CLI verb 'harness agents': table-ish output per agent — name, binary present (yes/no), version when present, enforcement tier; plus --json for machine-readable. stdlib only, offline, exit 0 always unless flags bogus.

tests/test_agents.py: existing 6 tests stay green; add registry tests — argv pinned per spec THROUGH the registry (not hardcoded names), unknown agent lists keys, 'harness agents --json' against fake PATH shims with one binary present and one absent asserts the booleans; fully offline.

TECHNICAL_PLAN.md: add 'Adding an agent' subsection: the fields a new agent must declare and that validation is 'harness agents' — mirroring lince-add-supported-agent's requirement contract. Honest note: enforcement asymmetry per tier stays (hook vs sandbox+verify).
Type-clean: uv run mypy harness/ must pass including the new dataclass/mapping. No new dependencies.

playwright.cmd: cd web && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npx playwright test e2e/dashboard.spec.ts
